description: A license's type (site, unlimited or reseller), billing (once or subscription), status (active, past_due, canceled, revoked), when updates end, which versions it covers, the sites using the app, and whether a renewal or upgrade is on offer. Give license_id (from list_owned or get_account) or app_id (every license for that app). Needs the owner signed in.

app_id.description: An app id, e.g. "links": returns each license for it.

name: get_license
title: One license in detail
